# 3D Deep-Sim Studio Engine & Harness Compact API Sheet (`studio/llms.txt`)
#
# Borrowed from the VibeGame `llms.txt` pattern: Agents MUST read this compact
# API sheet instead of scanning full engine/harness source files.

## 1. Studio Harness CLI Commands
- `node harness/agents.mjs [list | show <id> | create <id> <Title> | json]`
  Loads all roles from `studio/roles/**/*.md` (5 default + unlimited custom roles/swarms) and presets from `studio/presets/*.md`.
- `node harness/route.mjs [--role <id>] [--prompt "..."] [--dry-run] [--status]`
  Executes `freecc:auto` multi-model failover routing across Vertex Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI Grok, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama with 30s+ cooldowns in `.studio/cooldowns.json`.
- `node harness/task.mjs [next | list | start <ID> | done <ID> [--force] | add "<Title>" --role <role> --priority P0..P3 [--type bug|study|balance|fun|playtest|review|docs]]`
  Manages `studio/NEXT.md` and synchronizes `studio/CURRENT_TASK.md`. `done` refuses until the task's done-check passes.
- `npm run handoff` · `node harness/handoff.mjs note "<what, why, next>"`
  The Producer's briefing from files (plan, log, decisions, queue, claims, gates, bugs, sign-offs, meetings). `studio/MASTER.md` maps the key documents.
- `npm run intake [-- --answers game.json | --questions]`
  Pre-production: questions (play length first; a demo is the easiest start), three phases, every layer yes/explore/no. Writes `studio/bible/bible.json` and `BIBLE.md`, queues studies, storyboards, R&D and the person's sign-off.
- `npm run bible -- [show | check | json | layer <id> yes|explore|no --by <name> | sign --by <person> | phase open <2|3> --by <name>]`
  The Game Bible. Until a person signs, build tasks are refused; after, they need `--phase 1|2|3` and `--serves pillar:<name>|layer:<id>` (or `--idea I-001`), and can't touch a crossed-out layer. `--prototype` and `--infra` pass in pre-production.
- `npm run director -- ping --reason "…" | review | drift`
  The Director guards the Bible. Pinged daily by the HUB and by the Producer before it makes tasks; a ping queues one review task, writes `.studio/briefs/director.md`, and starts `STUDIO_DIRECTOR_CMD` (at most hourly). `drift` is a free report.
- `npm run idea -- add "…" | route <id> | shape <id> --notes | place <id> --phase n | decide <id> approve|park|reject --by <name> | list`
  The Idea Board: captured, shaped (R&D), placed (planner, pings the Director), decided, scheduled (`task add --idea`). The watcher hands new ideas to the Producer.
- `npm run intake -- --followups [--model | --json | --answers f.json]`
  Follow-up questions per phase and per kept or explore layer (a fixed bank; `--model` adds checked ones from a cheap model).
- `npm run liaison -- draft --kind idea|direction|asset|question --title … --summary … | change | confirm <B-id> --by <dev> | drop | list`
  The Liaison turns a conversation into a brief, reads it back, and only on the dev's yes sends it to the Producer and the Director.
- `npm run experiment -- start "…" | task X-001 "…" | keep X-001 --by <name> | drop X-001 --by <name> [--only paths] | list`
  Tracked experiments: commits tagged `Studio-Experiment`, taken back out in full or in part with undo commits.
- `npm run ref -- add <url|file> --game … --feature … [--at 1:23] | attach R-001 <file> | frames R-001 | list`
  The reference library (media kept in `references/` or `STUDIO_REFERENCE_DIR`, index in `studio/references/`). Never shipped.
- `npm run asset -- add <file> --use game --owner … --licence … --by <person>` · `--use reference`
  Game assets with a recorded statement of who may use them (`studio/assets/manifest.json`); the `assets` gate checks every shipped file.
- `npm run bible -- voice [--tone …] [--do …] [--dont …] [--never "a, b"] [--example …]`
  The game's voice; in every brief for work players read or hear.
- `studio/personas/*.md` (first-timer, calm player, min-maxer, explorer; add your own)
  Players the studio judges through; `npm run fun` reads the game through each persona with a `lens:`.
- `npm run sign -- keygen | result --by <name> | verify <file> [--replay] | fingerprint`
  Ed25519-signed manifests of verified results (goldens' SHA-256, gates, commit). `docs/SIGNED-RESULTS-AND-DATA.md`.
- `npm run trajectories -- preview | export --consent "…" --licence "…" [--with-briefs]`
  Opt-in, scrubbed, labelled records of finished tasks for evaluating or training models; `.studio/exports/`.
- `npm run learn [-- backup --to <folder>]`
  What keeps happening, lessons that didn't stick, suggestions never handled, the overseer's evaluations; daily by the HUB, backed up to `STUDIO_BACKUP_DIR`.
- `node harness/meeting.mjs start "<topic>" --with a,b | say "<text>" --agent <name> | end [--decision "..."] [--action "title|role|P2"] | status`
  A Producer meeting with several agents. Notes in `studio/meetings/`, actions become tasks.
- `node harness/task.mjs pause <ID> --agent <you> --note "<where you stopped>"`
  Hands a task back (out of usage, swapped, stuck): top of the queue, claim released, note in `studio/handoffs/<ID>.md` shown to the next agent.
- `npm run watch [-- --loop 300]`
  Zero-token watcher: requeues work whose claim expired, flags silent agents and provider outages, pings the Producer with one `Watch:` task. Runs on its own every 5 minutes while the HUB is up (`STUDIO_WATCH_INTERVAL`, 0 = off) and at `npm run session:start`.
- `npm run onboard -- --path <game folder> --name "<name>" [--dry-run]`
  Brings an existing game in: read-only scan, `studio/game/GAME.md` fact sheet, onboarding tasks. Guide: `docs/ONBOARDING-A-GAME.md`.
- `node harness/task.mjs reopen <ID> --reason "<what was wrong>"` · `task add ... --size 1-5 --caused-by T-012`
  Reopen finished work, or file a bug against the task whose work caused it. Both count against the model that closed that task.
- `npm run scorecard` · `npm run retro`
  Bugs and slips per model (per 10 points of task size). Bugs without `--caused-by` are traced through commit trailers to the commit and model that last touched the fixed code. Daily retrospective with suggestions in `studio/memory/retros/` (scripts, no tokens; the HUB writes one a day).
- `npm run studio:reset -- --name "<game>" [--yes]`
  Fresh plan, log and queue for a new game in your own copy; the old project's notes are archived to `.studio/archive/`.
- `npm run kickoff -- --role <role> --agent <unique> --model <model> [--tool claude|codex|cursor|grok|agy|aider]`
  Paste-ready opening prompt for any agent tool: who it is, its env, its role and the work loop. `--tool` adds a headless launch line (`docs/AGENT-TOOLS.md`).
- `npm run brief -- <ID> [--model] [--template] [--force]`
  Cheap prepare, strong act: a 300-word brief from a bounded window of the task's history. With `--model` a local or free model drafts it and a script checks it (sections, word cap, real files and task IDs). Skips the model when the history is short. Writes `.studio/briefs/<ID>.prepared.md`.
- `npm run models:check [-- --dry-run]`
  Asks each provider you have a key for which models it serves (free model-list endpoints, no tokens); exits 1 if a configured model is gone.
- `npm run focus -- <ID>` (written for you by `task start`)
  The agent's one-page brief in `.studio/briefs/<ID>.md`: done means, the skill's steps, notes from before, lanes, related lessons, finish commands.
- `npm run notes -- add --kind well|bad|workaround|upgrade "…"` · `list` · `export`
  Notes about the harness itself (`studio/harness-notes/NOTES.md`); kept across `studio:reset`.
- Commits made with `STUDIO_LOCK_OWNER` set get `Studio-Agent`, `Studio-Model` and `Studio-Task` trailers (commit-msg hook).
- `node harness/done-check.mjs <ID>`
  Shows a task's type and its checklist (`[x]`/`[ ]`): content checks, not file times. One skill per type in `studio/skills/`.
- `node harness/plugins.mjs [list | enable <id> | disable <id> | mcp]`
  Outside tools agents can use (`studio/plugins.json`): REA, Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, Blender, Godot, Unity.
- `node harness/event.mjs --type <event.type> --agent <role> [--task <ID>] [--to producer] --msg "<summary>"`
  Appends a zero-token telemetry line to `.studio/events.jsonl` (mirror only if AGENT_EVENTS_MIRROR is set).
- `node harness/status.mjs [--json]`
  Prints a 0-token studio snapshot combining queue, router matrix, and recent events.
- `node hub/server.mjs` (home page: War Room v3; `?skin=tycoon` for the Studio view; the old page is at `/legacy` until it is removed)
  Views: Ops, Studio Tycoon, Game plan (phases, layers, Idea Board, Director; `?skin=plan`). Endpoints: `GET /api/bible`, `POST /api/intake`, `POST /api/bible/sign`, `GET|POST /api/ideas`, `POST /api/inbox`.
  Click an agent for its drawer: current task, checklist, skill steps, hand-off notes, claims, score (`GET /api/agent?name=`; file reads only, no AI).
  Starts the Zero-Token Passive Workflow UI HUB (`http://127.0.0.1:3847/?token=<HUB_TOKEN>`; `?view=mobile` for phones).
- `node qa/playtest.mjs [--stage 1|2] [--cartridge name] [--scenario name] [--seed 1337] [--ticks N] [--url http://127.0.0.1:5173/?playtest=1]`
  Runs Stage 1 programmatic trajectory QA + Stage 2 Playwright accessibility/UISentinel layout QA and writes reports to `qa/reports/`.
- `node scripts/check-sim-purity.mjs`
  Static scan + runtime traps: no DOM, renderers, randomness, clock or timers in `src/sim/` or `cartridges/`.

## 2. Simulation Cartridge Contract (`cartridges/README.md`, loaded by `harness/cartridge.mjs`)
`cartridges/<name>/index.mjs`:
- `createInitialState(seed, tuning?)` — plain JSON state; seeded Mulberry32 RNG state lives inside it.
- `step(state, actions|null)` — one fixed tick, returns a new state; `actions` is an array.
- `invariants(state)` — `[{ id, severity: 'P0'|'P1'|'P2', summary }]` (NaN/Infinity check added by the harness).
- `outcome(state)` — `'won' | 'lost' | null`. `TUNING` — every balance number in one table.
- `hashState(state)` optional — the display hash; default FNV-1a 64 in `harness/hash.mjs` (= `tools/golden.py`). Goldens and regressions pin the harness's SHA-256 of the state (`sha256`), never the display hash alone.
`cartridges/<name>/qa.mjs`: `scenarios['start-to-win'] = { seed, maxTicks, policy(state, tick), expect: 'won' }`.

## 3. Everyday commands
- `npm run new-game <name>` · `npm run verify` · `npm run release`
- `node qa/playtest.mjs --stage 1 [--cartridge name] [--scenario start-to-win]` — stops on the first failing tick
- `node harness/replay.mjs --trace .studio/last-seed-failure.json` — reproduce a closed-loop failure
- `npm run golden -- --update` — after an intended sim change; commit hashes with the change
- `npm run balance` / `npm run fun` — sweep `TUNING` (studio/balance/sweep.json) / fun proxies
- `node harness/lock.mjs claim path:<dir> --owner <unique>` · `node harness/task.mjs start <ID> --agent <unique>`
